estimation.category: Industrial IoT Asset Model Design & Deployment Tool
estimation.assessment: Offline-first designer, validator, documenter and deployer for Insights Hub Asset Management v3 models; now reads and caches every tenant's existing aspect types, asset types and assets for browsing, reuse in editors, validation and import, plus guardrails, cross-tenant copy and idempotent deployment.
estimation.dev_cost_rationale: 65-100 days: domain model + validator, type/hierarchy editors, tenant catalog read/import, docs, secure proxy with online CRUD, deployment engine with resume/rollback, tests.
estimation.business_value_rationale: Saves modelling and deployment effort across tenants, enables reuse of existing tenant models, and prevents attribute-billing and limit violations before go-live.
